9b MazePresetFile: Def 314 is in the rotation range (301, 317); first use of Def 314 in this build: one level draw RangeB(L.seed, 2): lo 0x818ebf3a mod 2 = 0; the counter advances (0 + 1) mod 2 = 1 and replaces the drawn index.
The instance loads File2 of LvlPrest Def 314: Act2/Sewer/SewNSW2.ds1.
5b PresetRoomsCreate: one room (the maze room is 12 x 12, at most 12 x 12); one level draw per room (DRLG_RoomCreate).
The full mode draws that DS1's floor and wall cells, looked up in the level type's tile files (DT1); the schematic mode draws the room as a box.

steps.text: Final composite: 14 rooms after 136 RNG draws (86 in the generator, 50 in the conversion). Drawn relative to the layout's corner; the game then moves the whole level to its place in the act (not drawn, shape unchanged).
calc: Warp (cyan mark): room 9, DS1 wall cells of orientation 10/11 with slot 0, so Levels Vis0 = 40 (Lut Gholein) (warps.md, warp slot cell). Entry is by level order: the lower id is taken as the way in. The act's link lists can override Vis at run time (warps.md § C); not modelled here.

Warp (cyan mark): room 12, DS1 wall cells of orientation 10/11 with slot 1, so Levels Vis1 = 40 (Lut Gholein) (warps.md, warp slot cell). Entry is by level order: the lower id is taken as the way in. The act's link lists can override Vis at run time (warps.md § C); not modelled here.

Warp (cyan mark): room 14, DS1 wall cells of orientation 10/11 with slot 2, so Levels Vis2 = 48 (Sewers Level 2) (warps.md, warp slot cell). Exit is by level order: the lower id is taken as the way in. The act's link lists can override Vis at run time (warps.md § C); not modelled here.
Placement shift (maze.md G1): growth never looks at where the level sits in the act; rooms grow freely around the first room, so coordinates can go negative.
At the end the game takes the bounding box of all rooms (x0, y0) and adds (level.x - x0, level.y - y0) to every room, so the box's top-left corner lands on the level's origin in the act map.
It is one translation for all rooms: shape, doors and Defs do not change. This picture is already drawn relative to the box corner, so the shifted level would look the same.
